description: What kind of change is this task or PR?
instructions: What kind of change does this task or pull request make?

ui_visible.what: Changes what a person sees or feels in the app: layout, copy, motion, navigation, a new control
ui_visible.not_for: Refactors that leave every pixel the same

ui_invisible.what: Changes SwiftUI code but not what appears: a pixel-identical refactor or a rename

logic.what: Changes behavior or data handling that is not UI: state, parsing, networking, models

performance.what: Makes something faster or lighter without changing behavior

tests_only.what: Adds or changes tests and nothing else
tests_only.not_for: Changes that also touch product code

tooling.what: Scripts, CI, hooks, agents or build tooling

ha_config.what: Home Assistant configuration, automations or add-ons outside the app

dependency_or_build.what: A package update, project setting or build setting change

output: Task ledger field `kind`: the orchestrator's input to the autonomy level (L0 for logic, performance, tooling and invisible refactors; design.user_visible may only raise it).
evidence: Shadow. First measurement 2026-11-01 (single labeller, inline wording): accuracy 0.80; see contracts/jev/derived/measurements.md. Re-measure with this file's wording before promoting.
